name: Pet clearance calibration (lab)
description: Lab only (dossier 19d, gate C6): builds clearance fixtures (corridors 0.5/1/2 m wide with 1/2/3 m headroom, a doorway, two S-bends, a wide control) and, for each creature of kiln/data/pets-clearance-lab/plan.json, spawned without an owner and held by Kiln.Pets' broker leases, sweeps kiln.queries route requirements and walks every accepted route with Kiln.Pets' real follower and mover (catch-up and teleport off), the body's own walker as the comparison. Evidence in kiln/data/pets-clearance-lab/runs.jsonl for tools/pets-clearance/profiles.py. Needs kiln/data/kiln.creatures/force-ready.
